supporting_observations.claim: Ana Ruiz ran PowerShell to compress the \FILE-PIN-01\Shared\Clients directory into C:\Users\ana.ruiz\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip; Sysmon recorded the archive being created and the process exiting.

Shortly afterward, Ana launched Edge to dropzone-transfer.net. The proxy recorded a CONNECT attempt that received status 407 (authentication required) and terminated; the associated connection record shows only 404 origin bytes, not a tens-of-megabytes transfer.

The close sequence of archiving client-share data and then accessing an unapproved file-transfer service supports a malicious exfiltration-attempt finding, although it does not show that the archive was uploaded.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not establish the size or contents of c.zip.
The proxy record shows an authentication-required denial and termination, not a successful upload; the supplied evidence does not corroborate the alert's reported large outbound transfer.
The records do not show whether the user later retried the transfer through another route or service.
claims_not_established: That any client data or the created archive was successfully transmitted outside the organization.
That the archive contained sensitive or regulated information.
The user's intent or whether there was an authorized business purpose for creating the archive.

Determine the size, contents, and subsequent handling of C:\Users\ana.ruiz\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip.
Review proxy, endpoint, and network telemetry for retries or other successful outbound transfers after the denied CONNECT.
